name: Cult UI
summary: Free MIT animated shadcn/Tailwind components (Cult Pro templates/blocks excluded).
gaps: Pilot includes 12 free registry UI items of ~78 registry:ui entries in GitHub registry.json — not a full inventory.
Freemium: free MIT OSS at cult-ui.com / nolly-studio/cult-ui; Cult Pro at https://www.pro.cult-ui.com (paid blocks/templates/AI patterns) — Pro excluded; no paid unlock.
Live cult-ui.com returns Vercel Security Checkpoint 429 to plain curl/bots; docs + registry JSON verified HTTP 200 via Playwright (Chrome channel) and via GitHub raw / jsDelivr mirrors.
Some comps need peer packages (@paper-design/shaders-react, metal-fx, dither-plugin, three/jotai) and/or shadcn button/badge.
ARCHITECTURE §5 prefers iframe for unusual/tactile motion; all demos are docs iframes.
Optional `@cult-ui` registry alias documented on installation page; catalog copyCode uses full registry URL form from MDX.

components.name: Hero Dithering
components.summary: Split-layout hero with responsive dithering shader visuals, CTA, and tech badges.
components.copyCode:
npx shadcn@latest add https://cult-ui.com/r/hero-dithering.json

import { HeroDithering } from "@/components/ui/hero-dithering"

<HeroDithering />

copyPrompt.text: Use Cult UI free component `Hero Dithering` (slug `hero-dithering`) from https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/hero-dithering. Install with `npx shadcn@latest add https://cult-ui.com/r/hero-dithering.json` after `npx shadcn@latest init` (or configure `@cult-ui` registry: `"@cult-ui": "https://cult-ui.com/r/{name}.json"` then `npx shadcn@beta add @cult-ui/hero-dithering`). Registry item: https://cult-ui.com/r/hero-dithering.json (GitHub mirror also publishes the same JSON under nolly-studio/cult-ui). Import from `@/components/ui/hero-dithering` after CLI add (path may follow project aliases). Requires React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS; many items need `motion` and/or peer deps listed in registry. Free & open source MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nolly-studio/cult-ui/main/LICENSE.md); Cult Pro (https://www.pro.cult-ui.com) is separate — prefer free-tier only; do not unlock Pro.
